that is already in the shared catalogue, returns that row with ``existing: true`` instead of
creating a second one — the caller uses the returned ``id`` either way.

Settlement and billing report: the credit ledger (consume, settle, topup) aggregated by a
group_by key.

Consumption and top-ups join CreditTransaction to CreditWallet and are attributed to the owner
(organization, group, or user). gpu_hours is a best-effort sum of the occupancy hours of GPU
sessions overlapping [from_, to].

AuditLogEntry.title: AuditLogEntry
AuditLogEntry.description: One audit-log row as projected by ``_audit_view`` (+ resolved actor_name).

ClusterRead.title: ClusterRead
ClusterRead.description: One cluster as projected by ``_serialize_cluster`` (list rows).

ClusterResource.title: ClusterResource
ClusterResource.description: One host-compute dimension fleet-wide: promised to active sessions vs node capacity.

DashboardCompute.title: DashboardCompute
DashboardCompute.description:
Host compute held by the caller's active sessions — separate from GPU/credits, since
cpu/mem/disk are quota-governed, not billed.

DashboardCredit.title: DashboardCredit
DashboardCredit.description: Owner wallet snapshot; all None when the user has no wallet.

DashboardPool.title: DashboardPool
DashboardPool.description: A node pool the caller may place on. `id` is None for the unassigned ("shared") bucket.

DashboardRegion.title: DashboardRegion
DashboardRegion.description:
Per-GPU-model availability bucket.

`free`/`total` count whole cards, which under fractional sharing understates what is usable: a
card holding one small slice is not "free" yet can still host several more sessions. The VRAM
figures are what actually decide whether a session starts, so both are reported.

ForceTerminateBody.title: ForceTerminateBody
ForceTerminateBody.description: Admin's justification — recorded verbatim in the audit log (the console requires it).

ImageBuildRead.title: ImageBuildRead
ImageBuildRead.description: One build row as projected by ``_serialize_build``.

ImageRead.title: ImageRead
ImageRead.description:
One catalog image as projected by ``_serialize_image``.

``import_status`` is only present for imported/registered rows, so it is Optional.

MeMembership.title: MeMembership
MeMembership.description: One membership row resolved for the context switcher / RBAC.

MyVram.title: MyVram
MyVram.description: The caller's own VRAM footprint vs their policy limit (None = unlimited).

OperatorGpuDeviceUpsert.title: OperatorGpuDeviceUpsert
OperatorGpuDeviceUpsert.description:
GPU device inventory upsert (operator InventoryReconciler -> ledger).

Pure reflection of measured device-plugin/DCGM capacity. The control plane preserves
ledger-owned occupancy (used_mem_mb/used_cores) — those are NOT overwritten from here.

OperatorNodeHealthEvent.title: OperatorNodeHealthEvent
OperatorNodeHealthEvent.description:
Node health transition (operator HealthReconciler -> ledger).

On a critical breach (e.g. fatal Xid) the operator cordons the node and reports this; the
control plane records a NodeHealthEvent and marks GpuNode.status=cordoned.

OperatorNodeUpsert.title: OperatorNodeUpsert
OperatorNodeUpsert.description:
Upsert node inventory, reporting capacity for every node whether or not it has a GPU.

GPU-less nodes — CPU workers and the control plane — still contribute their cpu, mem, and disk
to the displayed inventory and the capacity calculation.

OperatorSessionDisk.title: OperatorSessionDisk
OperatorSessionDisk.description:
Ephemeral (scratch) disk usage of one session pod, read from kubelet /stats/summary.

``name`` is the GShareSession CR name — the sanitized session id (``ses-01abc...``).

OperatorStatusEvent.title: OperatorStatusEvent
OperatorStatusEvent.description: Status callback payload. Drives consume/settle triggers.

OperatorVolumeObserved.title: OperatorVolumeObserved
OperatorVolumeObserved.description: One PVC the operator sees in the session namespace (label gshare.io/volume).

OperatorVolumeSync.title: OperatorVolumeSync
OperatorVolumeSync.description: POST /internal/volumes/sync — the operator's periodic view of every session-volume PVC.

QueueEntryView.title: QueueEntryView
QueueEntryView.description: One queue entry as projected by ``_entry_view`` (status is always ``queued``).

ResourceUsage.title: ResourceUsage
ResourceUsage.description:
One compute dimension: what the caller's active sessions hold vs the policy limit
(None = no limit configured).

SessionMountRead.title: SessionMountRead
SessionMountRead.description: One mounted volume, joined with its display facts for the detail screens.

SpendDayRead.title: SpendDayRead
SpendDayRead.description: One day of spend (consume + storage), for the wallet's usage chart.

VolumePatch.title: VolumePatch
VolumePatch.description:
Owner-side edits. The quota is self-service in both directions (bounded below by usage and
above by the scope's storage policy on the server).

VolumeSyncDirective.title: VolumeSyncDirective
VolumeSyncDirective.description: What the control plane wants for one observed PVC.
